DP_timing_policy: Separately charged upfront build; all arms and references use warm profiles.
DP_work_definition: Two next-belief interpolation queries per grid state and backward time step; numeric cache bytes exclude Python object overhead.

protocol.all_fallback_diagnostic: Zero applied decisions or any hidden fallback invalidates efficacy attribution; report engineering failure separately.
protocol.artifact_policy: Incremental per-arm checkpoints are written before test scoring, followed by scores and complete-seed receipts. Late failures, final seal mismatches and final artifact-size errors retain completed work and an invalid-attempt receipt. Final aggregate results include actual trained arrays and hashes. Independent audit regenerates validation and repeats grid/tie selection as well as test scoring without training. Event streams are regenerable; no fabricated native application evidence.
protocol.claim_scope: Small synthetic hard-spiking learning benchmark; separate from Gaussian owner engineering profile and native deployment.
protocol.dynamics: Eight bipolar discrete integrate-and-fire cells with subtractive reset, fixed unit leak, cumulative signed-spike readout; identical dynamics in all six arms.
protocol.execution_accounting: The compact reference implementation evaluates all visible prefixes in a dense batch. Hard inference and fixed selection skip all surrogate CDF/slope/cache work. Actual full-prefix compute is separate from event-prefix work before stopping; the latter is not a measured hardware energy saving. DP cache numeric bytes/context count and next-belief interpolation queries are reported. All registered DP contexts are built and separately billed before any arm; later queries are warm. Raw-belief reference accumulation is inside its inference timer.
protocol.first_passage_gradient_semantics: Derivative of a finite-horizon killed constant-boundary Brownian hitting probability below threshold; constant extension above threshold. Used only as a local surrogate for discrete neural activations, not an exact Bernoulli-task transition kernel or moving-boundary theorem.

fixed_selection.tie_break: First pair in the declared nested upper-then-lower grid order on exact score equality

inference.interval: paired Student-t, 95 percent descriptive; Bonferroni 97.5 percent two-sided interval for two confirmation comparisons
inference.success: both adjusted lower confidence limits exceed 0.005 for a joint superiority claim; individual outcomes reported separately

protocol.infrastructure_failure_policy: Fail visibly on invalid/nonmonotone Bellman regions, nonfinite parameters or missing backend. No silently substituted arm, oracle, or successful parameter application.

neural_capacity.free_boundary_model_information: Known task reliability, cost and deadline; reported explicitly and shared with DP and myopic-VoC references.

protocol.neutral_decision_policy: Abstentions are retained in utility, duration and coverage denominators; neither deleted nor counted as correct.
protocol.primary_estimand: Paired per-seed OOD mean net utility: free-boundary minus direct-context for each gradient; confirmation family of two comparisons.
protocol.randomization: Independent split streams; episode-local SeedSequence(seed, split_id, episode_id); complete evidence streams generated before policy rollout and common across all arms. Training minibatch schedules and shared initial neural parameters paired across arms.
protocol.semantics: Terminal probabilities are not renamed first passage. Discrete task Bellman boundaries are grid-optimal Bermudan boundaries and do not independently establish continuous smooth-pasting.

time.primary: mean undiscounted net utility per episode
time.secondary: net utility per total serial physical duration including action and refractory

statistics.scope: Synthetic task only. Model-informed stopping benefit is not uniquely a neural/SNN contribution.
